name: Build: Softer shadows and stable cascades
body: Percentage-closer soft shadows, cascade blending and texel-snapped cascades so shadows stop shimmering. One PR based on nox-proto, with before/after screenshots, a guide page and a decision.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Spiral PCF with per-pixel rotation, cascade blending (D-069), lantern::lights::SetShadowSoftness, guide docs/shadow-softness-and-cascade-blending.md. Cascade texel snapping already existed. Penumbra widening with caster distance (blocker search) not done. 206 of 206 tests on lavapipe.
